'''''Limit Over Collection: The Heroes''''' is a [[booster pack]] in the ''[[Yu-Gi-Oh! Official Card Game]]'' (''[[OCG]]'').

== Features ==
* Introduces [[extended art]] cards.
* Introduces the [[Grand Master Rare]] rarity.
* Includes new cards from the [[anime]], used by [[Yami Yugi]], [[Rafael]], [[Team Ragnarok]], [[Paradox]], [[Crow Hogan (ARC-V)|Crow Hogan]] and [[Leo Akaba]].
* Includes reprinted cards with new variant [[artwork]]s.
* Introduces new members/support for the "[[Assault Blackwing]]", "[[Blackwing]]", "[[Code Talker (archetype)|Code Talker]]", "[[Dark Magician (archetype)|Dark Magician]]", "[[Djinn]]", "[[Dododo]]", "[[Elemental HERO]]", "[[Favorite]]", "[[Fusion (archetype)|Fusion]]", "[[Gagaga]]", "[[Gogogo]]", "[[HERO]]", "[[Junk]]", "[[Kuriboh (archetype)|Kuriboh]]", "[[LV]]", "[[Magician]]", "[[Malefic]]", "[[Number]]", "[[Odd-Eyes]]", "[[Pendulum (archetype)|Pendulum]]", "[[Pendulum Dragon]]", "[[Performapal]]", "[[Polymerization (archetype)|Polymerization]]", "[[Stardust (archetype)|Stardust]]", "[[Synchro (archetype)|Synchro]]", "[[Synchron]]", "[[Utopia (archetype)|Utopia]]", "[[Utopic]]", "[[Winged Kuriboh (archetype)|Winged Kuriboh]]", "[[Wingman]]", "[[ZS -]]", "[[Zubaba]]", and "[[ZW -]]" [[archetype]]s, as well as the [[-Eyes Dragon]] and [[Signature move]] series.
* Introduces the first support for the "[[Heroic Champion]]" archetype in the ''OCG''.

== Breakdown ==
=== Japanese and Korean ===
* There are 4 cards per pack and 15 packs per box. The set contains 80 cards.
** 38 [[Ultra Rare]]s
** 42 [[Super Rare]]s
* All cards are also available as [[Secret Rare]] and [[Prismatic Secret Rare]].
* 18 Prismatic Secret Rares are only available with an [[extended art]], and these extended art cards are also available as Ultra Rare and [[Grand Master Rare]].
* 21 Super Rares are also available as [[Ultimate Rare]].
* 21 Super Rares are also available as [[Collector's Rare]].

=== Simplified Chinese ===
* There are 4 cards per pack and 15 packs per box. The set contains 80 cards.
** 2 Prismatic Secret Rares
** 38 Ultra Rares
** 40 Super Rares
* All Ultra Rare and Super Rare cards are also available as Prismatic Secret Rare.
* 18 Prismatic Secret Rares are only available with an extended art, and these extended art cards are also available as Ultra Rare and Grand Master Rare.
* 65 cards are also available as Secret Rare.
* 20 Super Rares are also available as Ultimate Rare.
* 20 Super Rares are also available as Collector's Rare.

Notice how in addition to the monster being shown at different sizes, the background elements are also shifted around.}} '''Extended art''',https://www.yugioh-card.com/en/products/ra05/ known as '''Over-Frame''' (オーバーフレーム ''Ōbāfurēmu'') in the ''OCG'', is a type of [[artwork]] in the ''[[TCG]]'' and ''[[OCG]]'' that extends outside of its normal frame. It was introduced to the ''OCG'' in ''[[Limit Over Collection: The Heroes]]'' and to the ''TCG'' in ''[[Rarity Collection 5]]''. Extended arts are similar to [[Over Rush Rare]]s from ''[[Yu-Gi-Oh! Rush Duel]]'', but are not their own rarity; extended art cards are available in multiple foils, such as [[Ultra Rare]] and [[Prismatic Secret Rare]] (''OCG'') or [[Starlight Rare]] (''TCG''). They also differ in that, while the normal counterparts of Over Rush Rares are simply cropped, those of extended arts have their compositions altered to better fit within the smaller square frame. [[Grand Master Rare]] cards always have extended arts. {{-}} == List of cards with extended art == {| class="wikitable" ! Cards ! ''OCG'' release !
